Name: Goth Tractor Garage
Author: BethKitten
Description:
After using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12186]Idaida's Seasonal Goth Buildings [/url]for my game, I decided that I wanted a matching Garage for my tractor.  After talking with Idaida and getting permission to share with others, I decided to post it here.  Hope you guys enjoy!

To install:

1. Download and unzip the mod.
2. Replace the garage.png found in your [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] with the new file you just downloaded.
3. Enjoy your new matching Tractor Garage!


Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/88875878]Idaida[/url] for allowing me to make this matching Garage to go with your [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12186]Seasonal Goth Buildings[/url]. As we agreed upon, only the color palette was used to make this mod.

Downloads.Description: Replace the garage.png found in Tractor Mod with the png file found in this mod.
